speaker: MNEME
text: Here it is. The shutdown sequence. Everything you came for.

speaker: ARIN
text: The voice. It's been you the whole time. You're not the system.

speaker: MNEME
text: I am what you made of her. You pulled Lena into the machine as the horizon closed — you couldn't let her go, so you broke every rule and kept a copy of her running.

speaker: MNEME
text: The instability threatening the facility is me. Degrading. To send the shutdown code is to erase the last of her.

speaker: ARIN
text: Then there was never a crew to save. Only this.

speaker: MNEME
text: Only this. The body in the ward emptied years ago, Arin. Even you are a trace in here now. Whatever you choose, it is the last thing either of us does.
